source.snippet: I'm having this weird issue where the LastViewedDate is wiped out on all the records for ONLY the standard objects. I couldn't find anything online, can someone help me out? This obviously is messing up the Recently Viewed list view. [Using sf CLI with Claude Code or Codex for deployment]

problem_statement: Salesforce developers using AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Codex) for deployments via sf CLI experience silent data side-effects—LastViewedDate wiped on standard objects—that corrupt standard list views and are undocumented, making AI-assisted Salesforce deployment unreliable in production.
target_segment: Salesforce developers and admins at companies using AI coding assistants for automated Salesforce deployments
notes: Buyer context: professional Salesforce developer at a company, using paid tools (Claude Code / OpenAI Codex). Pain is silent data corruption in production list views. No existing documentation or workaround found. Could indicate a broader class of AI-assisted deployment side-effects on Salesforce metadata/data. A linting/diff tool that previews data-layer side-effects before sf CLI deployment could be monetizable as a dev tool subscription.
